description: Contracts for the tools exposed to the agent. Documentation only, not an n8n export.

agent.model: swappable chat model (not part of the contract)
agent.memory: windowed conversation memory keyed by the admin's sender id
agent.confirmation: every send needs an explicit YES / NO from the admin (prompt-enforced)

tools.name: STUDENTS QUERY
tools.combine: any filter (OR); unset filters get a value that matches nothing

tools.name: send_message_via_email
tools.implementation: sub-workflow: send the email, then log it to messages
preconditions: admin replied YES to the latest draft

inputs.admin_id: uuid of the admin row (mapped by the workflow, not chosen by the model)
inputs.subject: short subject line

tools.returns: a result message that the agent relays to the admin
tools.ordering: log only after the send succeeds

tools.name: Send To ALL Parents
tools.implementation: sub-workflow: read all parents, one email per parent
tools.note: the model never sees or handles the recipient list; the read currently has a test limit of 5 rows

tools.name: alert_developer
tools.implementation: message to the developer on a separate channel

inputs.error_details: tool name, what the admin asked, exact error text

tools.reliability: best effort; depends on the model following instructions

error_layers: agent error output: always replies to the admin and alerts the developer, no model needed
separate error workflow: catches crashes after the agent, set per workflow
alert tool on the agent: best effort for tool failures the agent recovers from
